body: Rupee record low ~₹96.5–97.2 (May 2026), ~₹94.2 on 13 Nov. US tariff on India 50%→18% (Feb 2026); IEEPA tariffs struck down 20 Feb 2026. India MSCI EM weight ~11–12%. FPIs sold record ₹1.66 lakh cr in 2025, ~₹2.45 lakh cr by Sep 2026; DII inflow FY26 ₹8.5 lakh cr. SIP record ₹32,490 cr Sep 2026, Oct ₹32,160 cr. RBI held 5.25% through Aug 2026. Nifty ~20.6x trailing; Smallcap 250 forward 21.9x vs 18.7x avg. STCG 20%, LTCG 12.5% over ₹1.25 lakh. STT from Apr 2026: futures 0.05%, options 0.15%.
title: India macro snapshot Nov 2026
